dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (日医標準レセプトソフト); compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL as part of the JMA ORCA project
evidence: COPY directives with .INC files (CPORCSC90.INC, CPORCSC91.INC, MCPDATA.INC, CPORCMCP.INC, COMMON-SPA)
No EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL
EVALUATE/END-EVALUATE, PERFORM VARYING, INDEXED BY usage consistent with COBOL-85

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance claim (receipt/レセプト) processing system — diagnosis act (診療行為) check and calculation subsystem
purpose.summary: This program is a subprogram within the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software. It performs checking, editing, and automatic calculation (算定) of medical procedure (診療行為) line items, including oxygen supplement handling, extinction/fire-extinguisher treatment checks, and workers' accident insurance (労災) additions. It is called with a mode flag (LNK-ORCSC-KBN) to select per-item check/edit, full-record check, or automatic calculation.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with multiple copybook-defined parameter areas (MCPAREA, ORCSC00AREA, SPA-AREA)
14 COPY statements referencing domain-specific include files (.INC)
SEARCH with SET and INDEXED BY for table lookup (oxygen code table)
Japanese EUC-encoded comments (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
No COMP-3, no SQL, no CICS
PERFORM VARYING with complex UNTIL conditions
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually Japanese EUC-JP encoding, appearing as mojibake. Content is clearly production COBOL from the well-known open-source JMA ORCA project (circa 2002). Truncated at 16000 chars; full file is 67294 bytes / 1615 lines.
